1CH 26:1.KJV: Concerning the divisions of the porters: Of the Korhites was Meshelemiah the son of Kore, of the sons of Asaph.
1CH 26:1.BHSA: לְמַחְלְקֹ֖ות לְשֹׁעֲרִ֑ים לַקָּרְחִ֕ים מְשֶֽׁלֶמְיָ֥הוּ בֶן־קֹרֵ֖א מִן־בְּנֵ֥י אָסָֽף׃

1CH 26:2.KJV: And the sons of Meshelemiah were, Zechariah the firstborn, Jediael the second, Zebadiah the third, Jathniel the fourth,
1CH 26:2.BHSA: וְלִמְשֶֽׁלֶמְיָ֖הוּ בָּנִ֑ים זְכַרְיָ֤הוּ הַבְּכֹור֙ יְדִֽיעֲאֵ֣ל הַשֵּׁנִ֔י זְבַדְיָ֨הוּ֙ הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֔י יַתְנִיאֵ֖ל הָרְבִיעִֽי׃

1CH 26:3.KJV: Elam the fifth, Jehohanan the sixth, Elioenai the seventh.
1CH 26:3.BHSA: עֵילָ֤ם הַחֲמִישִׁי֙ יְהֹוחָנָ֣ן הַשִּׁשִּׁ֔י אֶלְיְהֹועֵינַ֖י הַשְּׁבִיעִֽי׃

1CH 26:4.KJV: Moreover the sons of Obededom were, Shemaiah the firstborn, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, and Sacar the fourth, and Nethaneel the fifth.
1CH 26:4.BHSA: וּלְעֹבֵ֥ד אֱדֹ֖ם בָּנִ֑ים שְׁמַֽעְיָ֤ה הַבְּכֹור֙ יְהֹוזָבָ֣ד הַשֵּׁנִ֔י יֹואָ֤ח הַשְּׁלִשִׁי֙ וְשָׂכָ֣ר הָרְבִיעִ֔י וּנְתַנְאֵ֖ל הַחֲמִישִֽׁי׃

1CH 26:5.KJV: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, Peulthai the eighth: for God blessed him.
1CH 26:5.BHSA: עַמִּיאֵ֤ל הַשִּׁשִּׁי֙ יִשָׂשכָ֣ר הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י פְּעֻלְּתַ֖י הַשְּׁמִינִ֑י כִּ֥י בֵרֲכֹ֖ו אֱלֹהִֽים׃ פ

1CH 26:6.KJV: Also unto Shemaiah his son were sons born, that ruled throughout the house of their father: for they were mighty men of valour.
1CH 26:6.BHSA: וְלִֽשְׁמַֽעְיָ֤ה בְנֹו֙ נֹולַ֣ד בָּנִ֔ים הַמִּמְשָׁלִ֖ים לְבֵ֣ית אֲבִיהֶ֑ם כִּֽי־גִבֹּ֥ורֵי חַ֖יִל הֵֽמָּה׃

1CH 26:7.KJV: The sons of Shemaiah; Othni, and Rephael, and Obed, Elzabad, whose brethren were strong men, Elihu, and Semachiah.
1CH 26:7.BHSA: בְּנֵ֣י שְׁמַֽעְיָ֗ה עָ֠תְנִי וּרְפָאֵ֨ל וְעֹובֵ֧ד אֶלְזָבָ֛ד אֶחָ֖יו בְּנֵי־חָ֑יִל אֱלִיה֖וּ וּסְמַכְיָֽהוּ׃

1CH 26:8.KJV: All these of the sons of Obededom: they and their sons and their brethren, able men for strength for the service, were threescore and two of Obededom.
1CH 26:8.BHSA: כָּל־אֵ֜לֶּה מִבְּנֵ֣י׀ עֹבֵ֣ד אֱדֹ֗ם הֵ֤מָּה וּבְנֵיהֶם֙ וַאֲחֵיהֶ֔ם אִֽישׁ־חַ֥יִל בַּכֹּ֖חַ לַעֲבֹדָ֑ה שִׁשִּׁ֥ים וּשְׁנַ֖יִם לְעֹבֵ֥ד אֱדֹֽם׃

1CH 26:9.KJV: And Meshelemiah had sons and brethren, strong men, eighteen.
1CH 26:9.BHSA: וְלִמְשֶֽׁלֶמְיָ֗הוּ בָּנִ֧ים וְאַחִ֛ים בְּנֵי־חָ֖יִל שְׁמֹונָ֥ה עָשָֽׂר׃ ס

1CH 26:10.KJV: Also Hosah, of the children of Merari, had sons; Simri the chief, (for though he was not the firstborn, yet his father made him the chief;)
1CH 26:10.BHSA: וּלְחֹסָ֥ה מִן־בְּנֵי־מְרָרִ֖י בָּנִ֑ים שִׁמְרִ֤י הָרֹאשׁ֙ כִּ֣י לֹא־הָיָ֣ה בְכֹ֔ור וַיְשִׂימֵ֥הוּ אָבִ֖יהוּ לְרֹֽאשׁ׃

1CH 26:11.KJV: Hilkiah the second, Tebaliah the third, Zechariah the fourth: all the sons and brethren of Hosah were thirteen.
1CH 26:11.BHSA: חִלְקִיָּ֤הוּ הַשֵּׁנִי֙ טְבַלְיָ֣הוּ הַשְּׁלִשִׁ֔י זְכַרְיָ֖הוּ הָרְבִעִ֑י כָּל־בָּנִ֧ים וְאַחִ֛ים לְחֹסָ֖ה שְׁלֹשָׁ֥ה עָשָֽׂר׃

1CH 26:12.KJV: Among these were the divisions of the porters, even among the chief men, having wards one against another, to minister in the house of the LORD.
1CH 26:12.BHSA: לְ֠אֵלֶּה מַחְלְקֹ֨ות הַשֹּֽׁעֲרִ֜ים לְרָאשֵׁ֧י הַגְּבָרִ֛ים מִשְׁמָרֹ֖ות לְעֻמַּ֣ת אֲחֵיהֶ֑ם לְשָׁרֵ֖ת בְּבֵ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃

1CH 26:13.KJV: And they cast lots, as well the small as the great, according to the house of their fathers, for every gate.
1CH 26:13.BHSA: וַיַּפִּ֨ילוּ גֹורָלֹ֜ות כַּקָּטֹ֧ן כַּגָּדֹ֛ול לְבֵ֥ית אֲבֹותָ֖ם לְשַׁ֥עַר וָשָֽׁעַר׃ פ

1CH 26:14.KJV: And the lot eastward fell to Shelemiah. Then for Zechariah his son, a wise counsellor, they cast lots; and his lot came out northward.
1CH 26:14.BHSA: וַיִּפֹּ֧ל הַגֹּורָ֛ל מִזְרָ֖חָה לְשֶֽׁלֶמְיָ֑הוּ וּזְכַרְיָ֨הוּ בְנֹ֜ו יֹועֵ֣ץ׀ בְּשֶׂ֗כֶל הִפִּ֨ילוּ֙ גֹּֽורָלֹ֔ות וַיֵּצֵ֥א גֹורָלֹ֖ו צָפֹֽונָה׃ ס

1CH 26:15.KJV: To Obededom southward; and to his sons the house of Asuppim.
1CH 26:15.BHSA: לְעֹבֵ֥ד אֱדֹ֖ם נֶ֑גְבָּה וּלְבָנָ֖יו בֵּ֥ית הָאֲסֻפִּֽים׃

1CH 26:16.KJV: To Shuppim and Hosah the lot came forth westward, with the gate Shallecheth, by the causeway of the going up, ward against ward.
1CH 26:16.BHSA: לְשֻׁפִּ֤ים וּלְחֹסָה֙ לַֽמַּעֲרָ֔ב עִ֚ם שַׁ֣עַר שַׁלֶּ֔כֶת בַּֽמְסִלָּ֖ה הָעֹולָ֑ה מִשְׁמָ֖ר לְעֻמַּ֥ת מִשְׁמָֽר׃

1CH 26:17.KJV: Eastward were six Levites, northward four a day, southward four a day, and toward Asuppim two and two.
1CH 26:17.BHSA: לַמִּזְרָח֮ הַלְוִיִּ֣ם שִׁשָּׁה֒ לַצָּפֹ֤ונָה לַיֹּום֙ אַרְבָּעָ֔ה לַנֶּ֥גְבָּה לַיֹּ֖ום אַרְבָּעָ֑ה וְלָאֲסֻפִּ֖ים שְׁנַ֥יִם שְׁנָֽיִם׃

1CH 26:18.KJV: At Parbar westward, four at the causeway, and two at Parbar.
1CH 26:18.BHSA: לַפַּרְבָּ֖ר לַֽמַּעֲרָ֑ב אַרְבָּעָה֙ לַֽמְסִלָּ֔ה שְׁנַ֖יִם לַפַּרְבָּֽר׃

1CH 26:19.KJV: These are the divisions of the porters among the sons of Kore, and among the sons of Merari.
1CH 26:19.BHSA: אֵ֗לֶּה מַחְלְקֹות֙ הַשֹּׁ֣עֲרִ֔ים לִבְנֵ֥י הַקָּרְחִ֖י וְלִבְנֵ֥י מְרָרִֽי׃

1CH 26:20.KJV: And of the Levites, Ahijah was over the treasures of the house of God, and over the treasures of the dedicated things.
1CH 26:20.BHSA: וְֽהַלְוִיִּ֑ם אֲחִיָּ֗ה עַל־אֹֽוצְרֹות֙ בֵּ֣ית הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים וּלְאֹֽצְרֹ֖ות הַקֳּדָשִֽׁים׃

1CH 26:21.KJV: As concerning the sons of Laadan; the sons of the Gershonite Laadan, chief fathers, even of Laadan the Gershonite, were Jehieli.
1CH 26:21.BHSA: בְּנֵ֣י לַ֠עְדָּן בְּנֵ֨י הַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּ֜י לְלַעְדָּ֗ן רָאשֵׁ֧י הָאָבֹ֛ות לְלַעְדָּ֥ן הַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּ֖י יְחִיאֵלִֽי׃

1CH 26:22.KJV: The sons of Jehieli; Zetham, and Joel his brother, which were over the treasures of the house of the LORD.
1CH 26:22.BHSA: בְּנֵ֖י יְחִֽיאֵלִ֑י זֵתָם֙ וְיֹואֵ֣ל אָחִ֔יו עַל־אֹצְרֹ֖ות בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃

1CH 26:23.KJV: Of the Amramites, and the Izharites, the Hebronites, and the Uzzielites:

1CH 26:24.KJV: And Shebuel the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, was ruler of the treasures.

1CH 26:25.KJV: And his brethren by Eliezer; Rehabiah his son, and Jeshaiah his son, and Joram his son, and Zichri his son, and Shelomith his son.
1CH 26:25.BHSA: וְאֶחָ֖יו לֶֽאֱלִיעֶ֑זֶר רְחַבְיָ֨הוּ בְנֹ֜ו וִֽישַׁעְיָ֤הוּ בְנֹו֙ וְיֹרָ֣ם בְּנֹ֔ו וְזִכְרִ֥י בְנֹ֖ו ושׁלמות בְּנֹֽו׃

1CH 26:26.KJV: Which Shelomith and his brethren were over all the treasures of the dedicated things, which David the king, and the chief fathers, the captains over thousands and hundreds, and the captains of the host, had dedicated.
1CH 26:26.BHSA: ה֧וּא שְׁלֹמֹ֣ות וְאֶחָ֗יו עַ֣ל כָּל־אֹצְרֹ֤ות הַקֳּדָשִׁים֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר הִקְדִּ֜ישׁ דָּוִ֣יד הַמֶּ֗לֶךְ וְרָאשֵׁ֧י הָאָבֹ֛ות לְשָׂרֵֽי־הָאֲלָפִ֥ים וְהַמֵּאֹ֖ות וְשָׂרֵ֥י הַצָּבָֽא׃

1CH 26:27.KJV: Out of the spoils won in battles did they dedicate to maintain the house of the LORD.
1CH 26:27.BHSA: מִן־הַמִּלְחָמֹ֥ות וּמִן־הַשָּׁלָ֖ל הִקְדִּ֑ישׁוּ לְחַזֵּ֖ק לְבֵ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃

1CH 26:28.KJV: And all that Samuel the seer, and Saul the son of Kish, and Abner the son of Ner, and Joab the son of Zeruiah, had dedicated; and whosoever had dedicated any thing, it was under the hand of Shelomith, and of his brethren.
1CH 26:28.BHSA: וְכֹ֨ל הַֽהִקְדִּ֜ישׁ שְׁמוּאֵ֤ל הָרֹאֶה֙ וְשָׁא֣וּל בֶּן־קִ֔ישׁ וְאַבְנֵ֣ר בֶּן־נֵ֔ר וְיֹואָ֖ב בֶּן־צְרוּיָ֑ה כֹּ֚ל הַמַּקְדִּ֔ישׁ עַ֥ל יַד־שְׁלֹמִ֖ית וְאֶחָֽיו׃ פ

1CH 26:29.KJV: Of the Izharites, Chenaniah and his sons were for the outward business over Israel, for officers and judges.
1CH 26:29.BHSA: לַיִּצְהָרִ֞י כְּנַנְיָ֣הוּ וּבָנָ֗יו לַמְּלָאכָ֤ה הַחִֽיצֹונָה֙ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לְשֹׁטְרִ֖ים וּלְשֹׁפְטִֽים׃

1CH 26:30.KJV: And of the Hebronites, Hashabiah and his brethren, men of valour, a thousand and seven hundred, were officers among them of Israel on this side Jordan westward in all the business of the LORD, and in the service of the king.
1CH 26:30.BHSA: לַֽחֶבְרֹונִ֡י חֲשַׁבְיָהוּ֩ וְאֶחָ֨יו בְּנֵי־חַ֜יִל אֶ֣לֶף וּשְׁבַע־מֵאֹ֗ות עַ֚ל פְּקֻדַּ֣ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מֵעֵ֥בֶר לַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן מַעְרָ֑בָה לְכֹל֙ מְלֶ֣אכֶת יְהוָ֔ה וְלַעֲבֹדַ֖ת הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃

1CH 26:31.KJV: Among the Hebronites was Jerijah the chief, even among the Hebronites, according to the generations of his fathers. In the fortieth year of the reign of David they were sought for, and there were found among them mighty men of valour at Jazer of Gilead.
1CH 26:31.BHSA: לַֽחֶבְרֹונִי֙ יְרִיָּ֣ה הָרֹ֔אשׁ לַֽחֶבְרֹונִ֥י לְתֹלְדֹתָ֖יו לְאָבֹ֑ות בִּשְׁנַ֨ת הָֽאַרְבָּעִ֜ים לְמַלְכ֤וּת דָּוִיד֙ נִדְרָ֔שׁוּ וַיִּמָּצֵ֥א בָהֶ֛ם גִּבֹּ֥ורֵי חַ֖יִל בְּיַעְזֵ֥יר גִּלְעָֽד׃

1CH 26:32.KJV: And his brethren, men of valour, were two thousand and seven hundred chief fathers, whom king David made rulers over the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh, for every matter pertaining to God, and affairs of the king.
1CH 26:32.BHSA: וְאֶחָ֣יו בְּנֵי־חַ֗יִל אַלְפַּ֛יִם וּשְׁבַ֥ע מֵאֹ֖ות רָאשֵׁ֣י הָאָבֹ֑ות וַיַּפְקִידֵ֞ם דָּוִ֣יד הַמֶּ֗לֶךְ עַל־הָראוּבֵנִ֤י וְהַגָּדִי֙ וַחֲצִי֙ שֵׁ֣בֶט הַֽמְנַשִּׁ֔י לְכָל־דְּבַ֥ר הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים וּדְבַ֥ר הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃ פ

records.name: Abner
records.distinguisher: captain of Saul's army and Saul's uncle (1SA 14:50)

records.name: Ahijah
records.distinguisher: Levite over the treasuries in David's reign; no verse of this set attests him

records.name: Chenaniah
records.distinguisher: chief of the Levites (1CH 15:22), descendant of Izhar (1CH 26:29)

records.name: David
records.distinguisher: son of Jesse (RUT 4:17), King of Israel (2SA 5:3)

records.name: Elihu
records.distinguisher: son of Shemaiah [Shemaiah], a valiant man (1CH 26:7)

records.name: Hashabiah
records.distinguisher: son of Jeduthun (1CH 25:3), chosen twelfth by lot (1CH 25:19), descendant of Hebron (1CH 26:30)

records.name: Hashabiah
records.distinguisher: Descendant of Hebron son of Kohath, officer west of Jordan under David

records.name: Hosah
records.distinguisher: one of the gatekeepers (1CH 16:38), to the west (1CH 26:16)

records.name: Isshiah
records.distinguisher: son of Rehabiah, son of Eliezer, son of Moses (1CH 24:21)

records.name: Jehiel
records.distinguisher: Gershonite, son of Laadan, whose house (Jehieli) kept the temple treasures

records.name: Jeriah
records.distinguisher: descendant of Hebron (1CH 23:19), chief among the Hebronites from Jazer of Gilead (1CH 26:31)

records.name: Joab
records.distinguisher: son of Zeruiah (2SA 2:13), commander of David's army (1CH 27:34)

records.name: Joel
records.distinguisher: chief of the sons of Gershom (1CH 15:7), son of Ladan (1CH 23:8)

records.name: Kish
records.distinguisher: a mighty man of valor [perhaps wealth or influence] (1SA 9:1)

records.name: Korah
records.distinguisher: son of Izhar (EXO 6:21) who rebelled against G-d and Moses (Numbers chapter 16)

records.name: Kore
records.distinguisher: father of Shallum, descendant of Korah (1CH 9:19)

records.name: Mattithiah
records.distinguisher: son of Jeduthun (1CH 25:3), chosen fourteenth by lot (1CH 25:21)

records.name: Moses
records.distinguisher: led Israel out of Egypt in the Exodus (EXO 13:3)

records.name: Obed-edom
records.distinguisher: second rank Levite, gatekeeper (1CH 15:18), the south gate (1CH 26:15)

records.name: Saul
records.distinguisher: son of Kish (1SA 9:2), King of Israel (1SA 11:15)

records.name: Semachiah
records.distinguisher: son of Shemaiah [Shemaiah], a valiant man (1CH 26:7)

records.name: Shallum
records.distinguisher: one of the gatekeepers (1CH 9:17), to the east (1CH 26:14), gatekeeper (EZR 2:42, NEH 7:45, NEH 12:25)

records.name: Shebuel
records.distinguisher: descendant of Gershom (1CH 23:16), officer over the treasures (1CH 26:24)

records.name: Shelomoth
records.distinguisher: son of Zichri (1CH 26:25)- had charge of treasures and gifts from David and others (1CH 26:26)

records.name: Zeruiah
records.distinguisher: mother of Abishai, Joab (1SA 26:6), and Asahel (2SA 2:18), sister of King David (1CH 2:16)
